description: Hermes profile -> Shopify agent-role resolution. Hermes parity is a hard gate in R10, so every delegate_task profile must resolve to an agent from the ratified R2 target roster.

baseline.imported_sha_subject: chore: import Agent Harness Game Studios framework as baseline

arithmetic.agents: 49 - 31 = 18 net reduction; 31 deleted + 18 rewritten = 49 accounted for; 18 rewritten + 13 new = 31 target
arithmetic.skills: 23 delete + 31 rewrite + 21 keep = 75 accounted for; 31 rewritten + 21 kept + 14 added = 66 target

product.purpose: Product vision; owner of the master request.md

dev.fallback_when: Task goal is explicitly architecture-shaped (new app layout, cross-cutting technical design, ADR authoring).
dev.purpose: Implementation lead; app-architect for per-app architecture work

tester.purpose: Test strategy, quality gates, dev-store verification passes

reviewer.fallback_when: Task goal is explicitly architecture review (tech debt, API version policy, structural critique) rather than App Store compliance.
reviewer.purpose: App Store review and listing compliance; technical-director for architecture review

devops.purpose: Hosting, CI/CD, environments, deploy to test store

resolution_rules: A Hermes subagent launched with profile P loads .claude/agents/<agent>.md from the profiles table.
fallback_agent applies only when fallback_when matches the delegated goal; otherwise the primary agent wins.
model_tier must equal the agent frontmatter 'model:' field once R2 writes agents; Codex resolves it through .codex/agent-models.toml per AGENTS.md.
A profile missing from this table is a pipeline defect: fail the launch rather than guessing an agent.
Per-app writes are isolated to the app named in the task; no profile may write another app's directory.

per_app_state.apps/<app>/: Per-app working state and source: app code, prototype/, app-local docs, app config
per_app_state.production/apps/<app>/: Per-app build and pipeline artefacts: sprints/, milestones/, session-state/, release manifests, kanban cards

attribution.action: Keep LICENSE; credit both projects in README.md
